name: fallen-tribes-web
description: Fallen Tribes TypeScript client. Renders with three.js; simulates with the Rust core compiled to wasm.

scripts.sim: cd ../engine/sim_core && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cd ../.. && mkdir -p web/public && cp engine/sim_core/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sim_core.wasm web/public/sim_core.wasm
scripts.test: npm run sim && tsc --noEmit && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
